requirements_summary: Workload types: interactive code completion (single-line + multi-line), semantic search across repo, refactor suggestions.
Latency/throughput targets: median suggestion latency 40-80ms warm; concurrent devs per host: 3-7; server-side batch reranking tolerant up to 200ms.
Model preferences: smaller quantized models (q4/q8) for on-device inference; option to pin to specific model versions; hosted fallback for complex generations.
Routing/fallback needs: local model by default, fallback to dedicated Redwood hosted endpoint when local model OOMs or license limits exceeded.
Security/compliance: SSO/SAML + SCIM provisioning, audit logs retained 1y, KMS for keys, optional customer-managed HSM.
Integration points: IntelliJ Platform SDK (PSI), FileBasedIndex hooks, JetBrains Marketplace distribution, telemetry to Redwood Console (tokenized).
